deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next implement housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference for this doc-slim wave.
description: Line counts of implement doc surfaces used as the housekeep measured-reduction reference. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT LARGER than these baselines, records the measured reduced|no-op verdict, and asserts the load-bearing tokens survived. Reduction is REPORTED, never MANDATED: an already-clean no-op is a valid PASS (coding-rules §6 / measure-reduction.py contract). The spec.md baseline was advanced 206 -> 220 in v2.5.0 (auto-maintainer-framework#212) to absorb the new, load-bearing `concerns[]`-emission bullet, then 220 -> 271 (and contract.md 32 -> 35) in FT-A (DESIGN §3.6.3) to absorb the load-bearing deterministic-test-gate section (test_gate.py + the test_verdict evidence field + the validity predicate). Re-anchored spec.md 271 -> 266 by the measured doc-reduction wave (auto-maintainer-framework#358) that slimmed restated rationale and decorative parentheticals with no load-bearing token loss. Advanced spec.md 266 -> 278 in v2.7.0 (auto-maintainer-framework#354) to absorb the new, load-bearing in-PR committed-build-tree regeneration bullet under 'Shipped implementer subagent'. Advanced spec.md 278 -> 291 in v2.8.0 to absorb the new, load-bearing supersede-on-retry bullet (close a prior open same-issue auto-maintainer PR before gh pr create). Advanced spec.md 291 -> 308 in v2.9.0 to absorb the load-bearing reads += work_orders (join) change and the never-planned / accepted-only-default / fetch-fallback implementer bullet. Advanced spec.md 308 -> 336 to absorb the load-bearing configurable-implement_test_command section (the three-way gate: null=run.py default / command / 'none'|'skip'=skip, resolved by a direct stdlib config.json read). Advanced spec.md 336 -> 353 to absorb the load-bearing 'PR closes its source issue on merge (Closes #<n> in the body)' bullet — the accept-path gh pr create embeds Closes #<source-issue-number> so GitHub auto-closes the issue on merge and populates closingIssuesReferences (repairing supersede-on-retry + verify-integrate orphan-detection). Advanced spec.md 353 -> 355 in v0.10.0 to absorb the load-bearing 'doer no longer emits closed (reject disposition moved to TRIAGE), validate_handoff stays tolerant of a legacy closed handoff' backward-compat clarification. Advanced spec.md 355 -> 378 (and contract.md 35 -> 36) in v0.11.0 to absorb the load-bearing 'Script-backed worktree setup + explicit PR base' bullet (the deterministic open_pr.py companion script that resolves the default branch, fetches it, adds the worktree off origin/<default> never local HEAD, and opens the PR with an explicit --base <default> — fixing the wrong-base STACKED PR bug #844/#846) plus the contract's open_pr.py provides/invokes entries. The gate still forbids GROWTH past this reference.
